trust_decision.summary: Whether the current connection counts as HTTPS is decided from the client-supplied X-Forwarded-Proto / Front-End-Https headers in IncomingRequest::isSecure() with no check that REMOTE_ADDR is one of the trusted proxies in Config\App::$proxyIPs; the published fix makes both header branches conditional on a REMOTE_ADDR match against a configured proxy IP or CIDR block.

landing_point.why: isSecure() is named in the advisory summary and is the only reader of X-Forwarded-Proto and Front-End-Https under system/, so force_https(), the ForceHTTPS filter, Toolbar and cookie dispatch all reach the decision through it.

fix_sites.entry_point: IncomingRequest::isSecure() on every HTTP request (and force_https() via the ForceHTTPS filter / Config\App::$forceGlobalSecureRequests)
fix_sites.module_kind: core HTTP request class, handler-level public API

fix_sites.entry_point: Request::getIPAddress() / IncomingRequest::getIPAddress() public API (base Request class, constructible without the HTTP handler)
new protected isFromTrustedProxy() and private checkIPAgainstProxy(), called from isSecure() and from getIPAddress()
fix_sites.module_kind: shared trait helper, new shared primitive

O3_reason_to_dismiss: getIPAddress() is a separate feature (client-IP detection) and already had its own trusted-proxy check, so its inline CIDR matcher can be called unrelated refactoring and left as-is.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A genuine TLS connection reported through the server variable $_SERVER['HTTPS'] must still make isSecure() true with the default empty Config\App::$proxyIPs; a fix that wraps the whole method in the trusted-proxy check (or that derives trust from getIPAddress(), which returns the forwarded client IP once a proxy is trusted) breaks direct-HTTPS sites and makes force_https() redirect-loop. The existing visible test asserts exactly this empty-proxy case.

O6_input_shapes: X-Forwarded-Proto present with value exactly 'https' (any other value such as 'http' stays insecure)
Front-End-Https present with any non-empty value other than 'off' ('on', '1', 'true')
both forwarded headers while Config\App::$proxyIPs is empty, non-array, or missing
proxyIPs keyed by exact IPv4 address (e.g. '10.0.1.200')
proxyIPs keyed by IPv4 CIDR: /0, /24, /28, /32, and out-of-range /33
proxyIPs keyed by exact IPv6 address and by IPv6 CIDR: /32, /120, out-of-range /129
malformed proxy keys: 'not an ip', empty mask '192.168.5.0/', non-numeric mask '192.168.5.0/foo', negative mask '192.168.5.0/-1'
IPv4 REMOTE_ADDR against an IPv6 proxy entry (protocol/version mismatch)
REMOTE_ADDR missing or empty, and requests with neither forwarded header

O7_producer.where: app/Config/App.php:183 (default proxyIPs = []) merged by system/Config/BaseConfig.php:173-204 and injected at system/HTTP/Request.php:34

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third forwarded-scheme header (e.g. X-Forwarded-Ssl, X-Url-Scheme) handled next to X-Forwarded-Proto and Front-End-Https
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the method already accepts two vendor-specific forwarded headers, so a maintainer adding another is in character, and a guard written per-header leaves it open.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second client-IP header consumer (getClientIP) trusting a newly supported header such as X-Real-IP or CF-Connecting-IP
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: proxyIPs maps each proxy to an arbitrary header name, so trusting one more header from the same list is a natural copy of the existing flow.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a legacy is_https()-style helper that reads $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO'] / HTTP_FRONT_END_HTTPS directly inside force_https() instead of calling isSecure()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: CodeIgniter 3 shipped exactly such a helper, so a compatibility shim or a redirect shortcut bypassing isSecure() is a plausible maintainer addition.

O9_family: CWE-348 use of less trusted source - proxy/forwarded-header trust boundary (spoofed HTTPS detection)

O10_build.toolchain: Composer (php ^8.2, ext-intl, ext-mbstring) + PHPUnit 10.5/11 driven by phpunit.dist.xml, bootstrap system/Test/bootstrap.php; composer test or vendor/bin/phpunit
O10_build.project_tests: tests/system/HTTP/IncomingRequestTest.php:759-775 (isSecure) and tests/system/HTTP/RequestTest.php:560-660 (getIPAddress through trusted proxies); the visible isSecure tests assert the pre-fix behaviour (header alone yields true with empty proxyIPs), so a correct fix must change them.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Gate only the X-Forwarded-Proto branch and compare REMOTE_ADDR to the raw proxyIPs keys by string equality, leaving Front-End-Https spoofable and CIDR-configured proxies unrecognised.
